title: Device for conveying and separating ferromagnetic parts

features.item: A housing containing a displaceable magnet and pole shoes with workpiece contact surfaces.
features.quote: Device for conveying and separating ferromagnetic parts, in particular long parts, in a conveying direction extending transversely to the longitudinal axis of the parts, comprising at least two magnet arrangements disposed on a frame
features.note: The reference discloses a device with magnet arrangements on a frame, which can be interpreted as a housing containing magnets.
features.refuted: The quote describes magnet arrangements on a frame for conveying parts, not a housing containing a displaceable magnet with pole shoes having workpiece contact surfaces.

features.item: A magnet displaceable along a direction between a gripping position and a release position.
features.note: The reference describes magnet arrangements but does not explicitly mention a displaceable magnet or distinct gripping/release positions for a magnet.

features.item: Pole shoes attached to the housing, each with a workpiece contact surface.
features.quote: with poles ( 68 ) of a different type facing one another which create a magnetic field penetrating the parts ( 2 ) to be conveyed
features.note: The reference mentions 'poles' which would act as pole shoes, and these poles face one another to interact with parts, implying workpiece contact surfaces.
features.refuted: The quote only mentions poles facing one another creating a magnetic field, not pole shoes attached to a housing with workpiece contact surfaces.

features.refuted: The quote describes poles creating a magnetic field penetrating parts, not pole shoes designed to guide a magnetic field portion to a workpiece contact surface.

features.item: A workpiece contact surface defining a contact surface angle of 170° to 190° with the displacement direction.
features.note: The reference does not provide any information about the angle of workpiece contact surfaces relative to a displacement direction.

features.note: The reference describes a device that uses magnetic fields to interact with ferromagnetic parts, implying magnetic force is used to handle them, though it focuses on repulsion for separation rather than gripping.

features.item: Housing extending along a longitudinal axis with displacement direction parallel to that axis.
